opennyai_summary.22_December_2014__arguments:
Being aggrieved with that order, this appeal has been preferred under Section 76 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 whereunder the appellant needs to deposit fee prescribed under the notification issued by the Central Government.
Since the appellant failed to get hold of the notification no fee could be paid.
Even stamp reporter could not point it out the amount which is required to be deposited.
Further, it was submitted that the appeal is also barred by time by 33 days.
opennyai_summary.22_December_2014__ANALYSIS:
In this situation, as per the appellant the appellant is at fix as to what amount is required to be deposited.
Thus a great prejudice would be caused to appellant.
opennyai_summary.22_December_2014__decision:
However, State is hereby directed to get hold of the said notification so that the amount which the appellant is liable to pay as fee be ascertained.
Meanwhile, the appellant by way of interim arrangement is directed to deposit a sum of Rs.
25,000/- by tomorrow i.e. 23.12.2014 by way of draft in the name of Registrar General, Jharkhand High Court, Ranchi.
Let this case be listed on 12.01.2015.
Till then, no coercive step shall be taken against the appellant- Laxman Mandal in connection with F.S.S. Case No. 27 of 2013-14 pending in the court of learned Deputy Commissioner, Deoghar.
A copy of this order be handed over to the learned counsel appearing for both sides.
Let this order be communicated to the court concerned through FAX at the cost of the appellant, as prayed.
